messages.subject: Project Drake — completion checklist
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

With completion set for Thursday 20 February, the completion checklist is attached. All conditions are now satisfied: CMA confirmed no reference on 6 February, Clydesford consent 30 January, Stratton consent 11 February. Documents are engrossed and held to order. Stephen Harwood's service agreement is agreed. We'll complete by exchange of signed documents and electronic transfer.

Elena
